principles: Gate-consumed facts require one normalized semantic owner across writers and readers.
Fail closed before persistence, but preserve explicit valid and legacy-compatible control cases.
Testability must not create production capabilities broader than the behavior being tested.
drivers: A live B-ebe4 contradictory delivery payload produced a false PASS artifact.
B-914f showed field-by-field repair and production env seams create avoidable extra DEV/review rounds.
The follow-up must remain small enough that its assurance cost is proportional to the two verified classes.

options.name: A: Targeted delivery predicate plus bounded seam guard
pros: Fixes the reproduced delivery contradiction at schema, writer, and both gate consumers
Reuses existing mutation-matrix and AST guard patterns
Can migrate the one arbitrary-path verifier seam without redesigning done_prepare
cons: Adds a small shared core module and process-fact updates
Static flow analysis must define explicit sanitizers and fixtures

options.name: B: Generic evidence envelope framework and repository-wide taint engine
pros: Could cover future schemas and sink classes broadly
cons: Large framework refactor with high false-positive and assurance cost
Would pull unrelated done_prepare and hundreds of env reads into scope

options.name: C: Patch delivery handler and delete only the known seam
cons: Schema and DONE readers could drift again
No mechanical prevention for the recurring class

chosen: A: Targeted delivery predicate plus bounded seam guard
rationale: Option A closes the two proven classes across their actual trust boundaries without reopening the already-correct validation reuse path or attempting an unbounded taint system. The delivery predicate becomes the total semantic owner; the seam guard recognizes only arbitrary env-derived filesystem/command data as forbidden and permits explicit sanitizers for fixed bounded behavior.

preMortem.scenario: The new delivery predicate rejects legitimate waived or legacy promises.
preMortem.trigger: Status/verifiedBy/waiverReason combinations are normalized without positive controls for each accepted state.
preMortem.consequence: Valid delivery reviewers cannot close stories or old signed artifacts become unreadable.
preMortem.mitigation: Generate a full accepted/rejected table, preserve legacy missing-status+verifiedBy semantics only if explicitly documented, and run gate integration against verified, met, waived, unverified, and legacy rows.

preMortem.scenario: The seam guard flags normal runtime environment handling or done_prepare bounded smoke controls.
preMortem.trigger: A text regex treats any process.env near a sink as tainted and lacks sanitizer/control-flow semantics.
preMortem.consequence: Large noisy allowlists or unrelated refactors expand the story.
preMortem.mitigation: Use a bounded TypeScript AST data-flow check for direct/simple local propagation, model approved numeric/enum sanitizers, include positive fixtures for PATH/runtime reads and fixed-command controls, and keep production scan roots to core/handlers.

preMortem.scenario: A test-only capability remains reachable through CLI payloads after the verifier seam migration.
preMortem.trigger: The replacement callback/path token is exposed in the command schema or accepts caller-controlled paths.
preMortem.consequence: An attacker or accidental invocation can still write or execute outside the intended test capability.
preMortem.mitigation: Keep hooks constructor-injected or compute paths under a fixed runtime temp directory from a validated opaque token; add E2E assertions that CLI args/env cannot select arbitrary paths.

preMortem.scenario: CLI, handler, machine, and done-oracle disagree despite the helper.
preMortem.trigger: One consumer retains the old verifiedBy shortcut or schema permits a combination the handler rejects with a different reason.
preMortem.consequence: False PASS or inconsistent user diagnostics recur.
preMortem.mitigation: Register the semantic owner as an L4 process fact, make the process-fact contract assert every consumer import/call, and run pairwise contradiction fixtures through both direct handler and DONE readiness paths.
